notes.title: Coming soon: CG 5 and CG: Girls 2
notes.content:
We're less than a month away (November 7, 2024) from the Early Access release of the fifth installment of the free-to-play offshoot of the Coloring Game franchise.

[h3]A trailer has been added to the game's page today.[/h3]

[h3]New in the game:[/h3]
[list][*]Ability to upload custom pictures for free (limitation on image size, maximum 125x125 px.);
[*]3D mode;
[*]The game is based on the Coloring Game: Studio core (improved performance relative to previous games in the series).[/list]

Don't forget to add the game to your Wish List and Subscribe to community news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3001970/Coloring_Game_5/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227820/Coloring_Game_51/


Adults add to the wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246900/Coloring_Game_Girls_2/
